capabilities: Roll unfinished tasks from the most recent earlier daily note into today's note
Gather unfinished tasks from past daily notes over a chosen lookback period
Place rolled tasks under a chosen heading and filter by source headings
Undo the last rollover and restore the previous note contents
Import settings from Rollover Daily Todos
extras: The README warns to turn off Rollover Daily Todos when switching, or new daily notes get their tasks twice. Tasks with custom checkbox characters count as unfinished unless listed in the finished markers setting.
intentEvidence: This plugin does what Rollover Daily Todos does, and adds
problem: Obsidian daily notes start blank, so unfinished tasks from the previous day have to be copied by hand.
